Attention to Detail
Our Philosophy

Renovations designed
around you

At Le Bâtiment LLC, we create custom interior renovations designed and executed entirely in-house. From 3D design to final delivery, our expert team handles every step without subcontracting — giving us full control over quality, design, timing, and budget.

Our strength lies in continuity and personalized follow-up. The same skilled team works on your project from start to finish, with regular site visits from the owner to ensure every detail meets the highest standards of craftsmanship and precision.

Inspired by European savoir-faire, we believe that exceptional renovations are built through attention to detail, durable materials, and uncompromising execution.

Discuss Your Vision
What We Do

Every space,
reimagined

01
Living Spaces
Complete overhaul of living rooms, dining areas, and open plans. Bespoke furniture, statement fireplaces, custom lighting — designed to reflect how you actually live.
02
Bathrooms
Luxurious bathroom transformations — Italian tile, walk-in showers, double vanities. Designed around your daily ritual, not a catalog.
03
Commercial
Restaurants, retail kiosks, showrooms. We navigate permits, fire safety compliance, and mall regulations — so your business opens on time, fully compliant.
How We Work

From first idea to final keys

01

Consultation & Vision

Free first meeting — no pressure, no timer. Michael and Julie listen to your vision, constraints, and aspirations before anything is designed or quoted.

02

3D Design & Quote

Your project takes shape in full 3D renders before a single hammer swings. You approve the design and receive a transparent, fixed-price quote.

03

In-House Build

Our own crew — no subcontractors. Daily progress updates via a dedicated WhatsApp group. The owner visits the site regularly to verify every detail.

04

Turnkey Handover

We don't stop at walls and floors. Furniture, curtains, tableware, finishing touches. You walk in and it's ready to live in from day one.

The Founder
"Beauty and bold design are not luxuries — they are the natural outcome of a different way of thinking, designing, and building."

Born in Belgium on April 15, 1985, Michael Meesen grew up in a highly entrepreneurial family where business, hard work, and ambition were part of everyday life. An entrepreneur from a very young age, he built Le Bâtiment LLC on a simple conviction: that exceptional interiors are accessible to anyone, provided you pair the right creativity with the right execution.

He is supported by Julie, who manages client relationships and project coordination — ensuring every client feels guided, informed, and reassured from the first meeting to the final handover.

Michael Meesen
CEO & Founder · Le Bâtiment LLC
